coverage.rationale: Formula definitions belong to C07/C14, not the value registry.
Atomic labour assumptions and policies are materialized.
Role, technical and control salaries have no registry default.
Algorithms are versioned by formula contracts and are not constants.
Atomic financial assumptions and illustrative policy values are materialized.
Responsibility/zeroing is a policy table, not a numeric fallback.
All three scenarios and annual ramp values are atomic entries.
Charging efficiency is materialized; capacity algorithms remain formulas.
Robot power/payload/item mass must be evidence-safe or explicit scenario input.
Optional/preset defaults are explicit scoped assumptions.
K16 accepts 17 important fields and denominator 77.
Accepted scoring weights and endpoints replace superseded penalties.
Safe object and visualization assumptions are scoped.
These values never populate vendor facts or calculation profiles.
Weights sum to 100; card-data denominator is separately 77.
R06 rationale is bound to the same atomic labour entries.
Safe split/total exchange facts are resolved per model/run.
Removed 80000 salary default is not materialized.
R06 financial assumptions share IDs with R02.
Ledger behavior is formula/policy, not a scalar constant.
RaaS line ownership is preserved for C17.
Every uncertainty axis and ramp year is materialized.
Accepted ranking parameters are materialized.
Accepted weights and synthetic visualization values are materialized.
10 picks/min is excluded from vendor calculation facts.
TRL/noise require scoped evidence; no default is created.
Mandatory/default behavior is a normalization policy.

supersessions.replacement_rule: Use accepted scoped applicability components and K14 curves.

supersessions.old_semantics: ambiguous RaaS payment inside OPEX subtotal
supersessions.replacement_rule: Payment is one separate operating line and enters cash flow/TCO once.

supersessions.old_semantics: percentage OPEX based on total CAPEX
supersessions.replacement_rule: Percentage OPEX uses equipment CAPEX only.
Hard checks and score components are separate; only accepted residual penalty remains.
Peak is intraday factor multiplied by one plus scenario reserve.
